about: The studio's video categories (vinari.ge/studio), the single source of their ids. The site keeps a copy of the id list (web/api/studio.js) and shows the labels; tools/ci/prompt.mjs puts one category's facts, screens and earlier videos into the brief; tools/build-index.mjs checks a spec's "category". Facts are short English, true to the app brief (Marketing/VINARI — app brief.md): the cloud may use nothing outside them. "feature": false = not one feature (a general video may not list it among the features it shows). "words": case-insensitive patterns that read the category from a topic typed without one (the longest total match wins; general only when nothing else matches).

categories.label: ზოგადი
categories.tier: one car and its price free, the rest VINARI+
facts: One iPhone app for a car owner in Georgia: today's price, customs, deadlines, the QR card, parking and more.
Every number carries its source and time; when a source does not answer, the screen says so instead of guessing.
No account: no email, no password.
Free: one car and its price today. Everything else is VINARI+.
Each feature shown keeps its own category's facts (ci/categories.json).
never: a feature list read out like an ad: one everyday story that passes through the features
calling a VINARI+ feature free

categories.label: ფასი და ბაზარი
facts: Today's price is the middle price ("შუა ფასი") of live listings ("ცოცხალი განცხადებები"), not the average.
It shows how many listings it counted and when: the source and the time are on screen.
Too few listings: it says so and draws no price at all.
It shows how many identical cars are for sale right now.
Free for one car.
never: the listing site's name
a price or a listing count read off a screen (they are live)
"free" as the closing line

categories.label: VIN ფოტოთი
facts: Add a car by photographing its VIN: the app reads it, on the phone.
No typing 17 characters by hand.
It is how the free car gets added.
never: calling the auction record or any VINARI+ feature free

categories.label: განბაჟება
facts: The calculator: the year and the engine go in, lari comes out, with excise, duty and fees shown apart.
The 1 January step: age counts from the declaration year, so the amount steps up on 1 January. 2020 · 2.0 L petrol: 3 610 ₾ today, 9 615 ₾ from 1 January (then "validUntil": "2026-12-31").
Hybrid, electric and right-hand-drive switches. Right-hand drive triples the excise only, never the total. No figures for hybrid or electric.
Works offline. Matched the rs.ge calculator in 29 of 29 cases.
never: "offline" or "the customs total" over 05-customs (it shows the budget to max bid mode and an online rate line)
"a late ship pays more" (say: a ship that arrives in January pays the new amount)
"წელს" in a film about the year changing

categories.label: ვადები და შეხსენებები
facts: Inspection, insurance, oil, tyres and six more types.
It reminds 7, 3 or 1 days before: you choose.
09:00 on every step; 19:30 only 1 day before and on the day.
Local: scheduled on the phone, no server.
never: 19:30 over the 7- or 3-day step
fines
the test entry "ტესტი, ვაკე" on 03-calendar-day

categories.label: QR ბარათი
facts: A windshield card, printed on A4 in black and white.
A passer-by scans it and taps one of three reasons, word for word: "მანქანა გზას მიკეტავს", "შუქები ანთია", "მანქანასთან რაღაც ხდება". The owner gets a push.
No number is shown anywhere, neither the passer-by's nor the owner's, and the plate is not on the card.
Quiet hours are optional and off by default.
Revoked in one tap; a revoked code never opens again.
never: "quiet at night" as if always on (quiet hours are off until switched on)
a promise that the owner comes (that is up to them)

categories.label: პარკინგი
facts: Remembers where you parked, offline.
Adds the floor and the row.
Says honestly when the spot is imprecise: ±40 m underground.
never: a floor or a row over a screen that does not show them

categories.label: ძრავის ხმა და ხელოსანი
facts: Records 4 seconds of engine sound and says: knock, squeal or hum.
Three questions tell you which of 11 mechanic types you need, in drivers' words (ხოდოვოი, კარობკა, ჟესტიანშიკი, მალიარი ...).
It never names a part and never gives a diagnosis: a guess, not a diagnosis.
never: "დიაგნოზი" or any medical word as the app's claim
naming a part
calling the mechanic finder free

categories.label: აუქციონი და ბიდი
facts: The wallet: your budget goes in, the max safe bid comes out, after ocean, port, fees and customs.
The lari rate comes from the National Bank (online).
A US auction damage record by VIN: what was damaged, which document, when.
The database is incomplete and the screen says so: "not found" does not mean "never crashed". Two of five VINs have no page at all.
never: "full history"
"any car"
30 000 ₾ or $6810 read aloud off 05-customs

categories.label: რასაც Vinari არ გეტყვის
facts: It will not tell you the owner: that record needs a sign-in on the state's own site.
No fines: they need your personal ID number, and the app does not ask for it.
No full auction history: the auction houses block automatic access, and the record it has says it is incomplete.
No search by plate: Georgia has no public plate database.
No part names from a sound: saying no is also an answer.
Every number carries its source and time; when a source is silent, the screen says so.
never: an apology: every refusal is said as strength
